fields.columns: | columns event.time, event.type, site.name, agent.uuid, src.process.storyline.id, src.process.user, src.process.uid, src.process.cmdline, src.ip.address, src.port.number, dst.ip.address, dst.port.number, src.process.parent.cmdline, tgt.process.cmdline
fields.description:
Detects the execution of "schtasks.exe" from a parent that is located in a potentially suspicious location.
Multiple malware strains were seen exhibiting a similar behavior in order to achieve persistence.
fields.name: Scheduled Task Creation From Potential Suspicious Parent Location
fields.query: event.type="Process Creation" and (endpoint.os="windows" and (((src.process.image.path contains ":\\Temp\\" or src.process.image.path contains "\\AppData\\Local\\" or src.process.image.path contains "\\AppData\\Roaming\\" or src.process.image.path contains "\\Temporary Internet" or src.process.image.path contains "\\Users\\Public\\" or src.process.image.path contains "\\Windows\\Temp\\") and tgt.process.image.path contains "\\schtasks.exe" and tgt.process.cmdline contains "/Create ") and (not (tgt.process.cmdline contains "update_task.xml" or tgt.process.cmdline contains "unattended.ini"))))
